comment: RESEARCH BASELINE (max50, no rotate). PRODUCTION SSOT as of 2026-08-03: config/trend_rotation_25_max8_rotate.json + config/live_paper.json (max8, rotate underwater-only, hold=14). Archived twin: trend_rotation_25_baseline_max50.json. Core DNA still breakout/slow_EMA/25% alloc.
_mechanics: Enter long when price breaks above the 60-period 4h channel AND price>trend_filter slow EMA (bull regime). Ride with NO hard stop (atr_stop_mult=0); exit only when price closes below the slow EMA. Cap each position at 25% of equity (max_alloc_pct) so up to 4 coins held concurrently. Long-only. Re-entries allowed after cooldown_bars=2 (8h).

results_consistency_3yr_split_25pct_cap.note: Beats BTC in EVERY 1-year slice of the 3-year period (up, flat, and down BTC regimes).

results_long_window_2020_2026_6p5yr_25pc.data_note: 12 coins have 2020 data (BTC,ETH,BCH,ETC,LINK,LTC,OXT,XLM,XRP,UNI,ZEC,AAVE); others start at listing (2023+).

benchmarks_note: Equal-weight basket of all 50 coins (+46.9% over 3yr) is NOT beatable by trend-following (ZEC +1603% / VVV +590% dominate the mean). The strategy beats buy-and-hold on 37/50 individual coins. This config targets the user's stated benchmark: beat buying-and-holding Bitcoin, with the strategy choosing coins.
risk: Capital is fully invested and rotates between trending coins; large interim drawdowns are expected (verify via strategies/portfolio_risk.py). Dry-run/paper only. Live trading gated behind explicit approval.
